title: Scheduled tasks
subtitle: Run a sequence of steps on a schedule: console commands, delays, start, stop, restart, force stop and backup.
not_yours_title: No permission to manage scheduled tasks
not_yours_body: Only the owner or an admin can view and change this server's scheduled tasks.
limit_reached: The scheduled-task limit of {{limit}} has been reached. Remove an existing task before adding another.
unavailable_body: felis-api has no schedule storage configured. Tasks cannot be read or saved. Contact an administrator to check the configuration.
empty_hint: Select a task template or select New task to configure a custom task.
dialog_desc: Configure the steps, execution time, and runtime parameters.
tpl_remind_restart_command: say The server restarts in 1 minute.
step_start_desc: Starts the server when it is stopped.
step_stop_desc: Stops the server. Online players are disconnected.
step_restart_desc: Stops the server and starts it again. Online players are disconnected.
step_kill_desc: Ends the server process at once, without saving. Online players are disconnected.
step_backup_desc: Backs up the world. A running server is backed up without stopping when that is possible; otherwise it is stopped first and started again afterwards. A stopped server stays stopped.
steps_hint: Steps run in order, up to {{max}} per task. A step that fails ends the run.
steps_limit: A task has at most {{max}} steps.
command_hint: Enter one console command. The leading / is optional.
once_hint: The task runs once at this time in the selected time zone and then switches itself off.
interval_hourly_limit: A task with a start, stop, restart, force stop or backup step repeats at most once an hour.
timezone_hint: Execution times use the selected timezone. Browser timezone: {{zone}}.
max_runs_hint: Leave empty or enter 0 for no limit. A run started by hand counts. The task switches itself off after its last run.
warn_hint: Before the run begins, posts a message in game chat, in Chinese and English, while the server is running. The wording follows the first step that stops, force stops, restarts or backs up the server.
backup_note: A backup step backs up a running server without stopping it when that is possible. Otherwise the server is stopped first, which disconnects online players, and started again after the backup. A stopped server stays stopped.
enabled_hint: Runs on schedule. Switch it off to keep the task without running it.
err_command_long: The command is longer than {{max}} bytes.
err_delay: Enter a whole number of seconds from 1 to {{max}}.
err_steps_action: Add at least one step that is not a delay.
err_steps_backup: A task can have only one backup step.
err_once_past: Pick a time in the future.
err_max_runs: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.
err_max_runs_used_one: The task has already run {{count}} time. Enter a larger number, or leave the field empty.
err_max_runs_used_other: The task has already run {{count}} times. Enter a larger number, or leave the field empty.
err_timezone: Unknown time zone. Use a name such as Asia/Shanghai.
err_label_long: The name is longer than {{max}} characters.
next_run_off: Disabled; runs only when Run now is selected
run_state_stopping: Waiting for the server to stop…
run_state_backup_stopping: Stopping the server for the backup…
run_state_backup_waiting: Waiting for the world to be free for the backup…
run_state_backup_restart: Backing up; the server starts again afterwards…
run_state_settling: Waiting for the server to be ready…
busy_hint: The task is running. Wait for the current execution to complete.
owner_changed: The server owner has changed and the task was disabled automatically. Verify the configuration before saving or enabling it again.
detail_no_world: The server has no world save.
detail_missed: felis-api was not running at the scheduled time.
detail_started_meanwhile: Another operation started the server before the task completed.
detail_interrupted: felis-api stopped in the middle of this run.
detail_store_full: The backup store is full. Ask an administrator to free space.
detail_console: The server console could not be reached.
detail_cap: The cluster is at its running-server cap.
detail_retiring: The server is being given up or deleted.
detail_stop_timeout: The server did not stop within 15 minutes.
detail_world_busy: Another operation kept the world busy for 15 minutes.
detail_ready_timeout: The server was not ready within 15 minutes.
detail_backup_timeout: The backup did not finish within 45 minutes.
detail_backup_gone: The backup Job was removed before its result could be read. See the Backups & restore page.
run_body: Carries out these steps now, in order: {{steps}}.
run_kick: Online players are disconnected right away: a run started by hand skips the players' warning.
run_counts: This run counts toward the limit of {{max}} runs.
run_keeps_next: The next scheduled run stays as planned. A one-time task, or a task that reaches its run limit, turns off after this run.
delete_body: The task will be deleted and will no longer execute. Its configuration will not be retained.
note_timing: felis-api checks every 15 seconds, so a task starts within about 15 seconds of its time. A run more than 10 minutes late (felis-api was down) is recorded as missed, and the next one runs as usual.
note_steps: Steps run in order. A step that fails ends the run as failed and skips the rest; a server that the run stopped is started again. After a start or restart that has steps behind it, the run waits up to 15 minutes for the server to be ready, and after a stop or force stop it waits for the server to stop completely. A command whose outcome is unknown is not sent again.
note_skip: A command step on a server that is not running skips the whole run. A start, stop, restart or force stop whose goal already holds skips a task of one step and is passed over in a longer task.
note_owner: Tasks are disabled automatically when server ownership changes. Saving a task again assigns it to the current owner.
note_run_now: Run now also works on a task that is off. It skips the players' warning and keeps the next scheduled run, and it counts toward the run limit.
